input.subject: Al Mada Catering LLC - documents needed to complete registration
input.body:
Dear Khalid,

Thank you for your registration documents. To complete onboarding we need two items:

1. Bank letter: account_confirmation.pdf was unreadable. Please reply with a clearer, full-page scan.
2. Zakat certificate: not received. Please send a copy.

Kind regards,
Procurement Team
